mapper.select: SELECT id, product_id, sku_code, name, quantity, cost_price, sale_price, weight, volume, image, status, created_at, updated_at FROM product_sku WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT id, product_id, sku_code, name, quantity, cost_price, sale_price, weight, volume, image, status, created_at, updated_at FROM product_sku WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT id, product_id, sku_code, name, quantity, cost_price, sale_price, weight, volume, image, status, created_at, updated_at FROM product_sku WHERE sku_code = #{skuCode} AND deleted = 0

SELECT s.id, s.product_id, s.sku_code, s.name, s.quantity, s.cost_price, s.sale_price, s.weight, s.volume, s.image, s.status, s.created_at, s.updated_at FROM product_sku s INNER JOIN product p ON s.product_id = p.id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE s.deleted = 0
AND (s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.sku_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND s.status = #{status}
ORDER BY s.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_sku (product_id, sku_code, name, quantity, cost_price, sale_price, weight, volume, image, status) VALUES (#{productId}, #{skuCode}, #{name}, #{quantity}, #{costPrice}, #{salePrice}, #{weight}, #{volume}, #{image}, #{status})
